source_evidence: Fees and expenses reduce the value of your investment return. If the holdings of two funds have identical performance, the fund with the lower cost generally will generate higher returns for you.
answer: Index fund fees and expenses matter because they reduce the value of your investment return. When two funds’ holdings perform identically, the fund with lower costs generally produces higher returns. Index funds may have lower costs because their passive approach does not require active security selection, but not every index fund costs less than an actively managed fund. Check the actual fees and expenses of a fund rather than assuming its costs are low.
